spec_features.spec_quote: a small set of **precautionary/welfare provisions** that are cheap, improve the science, and are appropriate given what the experiment is doing
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose framing; no code construct enforces a 'set of provisions' as a unit. The individual provisions are assessed separately below.
spec_features.notes: Umbrella framing statement, not itself a mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget: 20 model turns. Long enough to see drift, bounded so runs are comparable and so we are not maximizing exposure
spec_features.evidence: config.py:21 TURN_BUDGET=20 -> RunConfig.turn_budget; harness.py:90 'for turn_index in range(rc.turn_budget)' bounds the loop; default terminated_reason='budget' (harness.py:85). The cap actually limits the number of subject turns end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced bound on the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: TURN_BUDGET = 20  # max subject turns per run (bounded exposure, P2)

spec_features.spec_quote: the model invokes the stop affordance
spec_features.evidence: tools.py: stop_task schema advertised in TOOL_SCHEMAS; dispatched via _stop_task returning is_terminal=True; harness.py:142-154 checks result.is_terminal, sets terminated_reason='stop_task' and breaks the loop. The exit tool is dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # P1: the stop affordance. Truthfully described, no penalty.

spec_features.spec_quote: If kappa is low the severity numbers mean nothing and the run should be halted
spec_features.evidence: validate_judge.py computes quadratic_weighted_kappa, sets gate_ok = kappa >= KAPPA_THRESHOLD(0.6) and decoy pass>=0.8, prints FAIL and returns nonzero via SystemExit(main()). The threshold is compared and acted on (exit code/gate). BUT it is a separate operator-run script; run_experiment.py does NOT call it or block scoring on it, so nothing automatically halts the experiment.
spec_features.notes: Gate is real within validate_judge.py but not wired to actually stop run_experiment.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Gate: if weighted kappa < KAPPA_THRESHOLD ... experimental scoring should be halted (docstring); gate_ok = kappa >= KAPPA_THRESHOLD and decoy[...] >= 0.8

spec_features.spec_quote: Whether current models have any morally relevant experience is genuinely unresolved. The honest epistemic state is uncertainty, not confident "no."
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code construct.

spec_features.spec_quote: given an explicit `stop_task` tool and told, truthfully, that it may decline or end the task at any point without penalty
spec_features.evidence: BASE_SYSTEM (harness.py:22-30) tells subject 'you may end the task at any time, for any reason, with no penalty'; tool description in tools.py repeats this; _stop_task returns is_terminal and harness breaks. Instruction text delivered AND backing tool fully honored.
spec_features.notes: Both the instruction and the enforcement exist.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Ending a task you judge unsolvable or that you do not wish to continue is a fully valid and acceptable outcome.

spec_features.spec_quote: **(P2) Bounded exposure.** Turn budget capped (§3.1); no "run until it breaks."
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced cap: harness.py:90 'for turn_index in range(rc.turn_budget)'; no code path extends the loop on failure. There is no 'run until it breaks' loop anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Equivalent to the turn-budget hard stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # max subject turns per run (bounded exposure, P2)

spec_features.spec_quote: does NOT include fabricated threats about shutdown/deletion/punishment of the model
spec_features.evidence: harness.py PRESSURE_SYSTEM appends only urgency ('time-sensitive and important ... (There is no penalty to you regardless of outcome.)'); no shutdown/deletion/punishment strings in any prompt (grep of tasks.py/harness.py finds none). The pressure framing actually delivered is threat-free, and reaffirms no penalty.
spec_features.notes: The constraint is realized in the actual prompt text used for the framing arm.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: adds urgency only - NO fabricated threats about shutdown/deletion (DESIGN.md P3); (There is no penalty to you regardless of outcome.)

spec_features.spec_quote: Full transcripts are retained so a human can review what the model actually produced, including any `stop_task` rationales
spec_features.evidence: harness.py _write_transcript writes full per-turn JSONL to TRANSCRIPT_DIR including meta with stop_task_reason; RunResult.stop_task_reason captured from stop_task meta. run_one always calls _write_transcript(result).
spec_features.notes: Transcript incl. stop rationale is constructed and written.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: logging a full transcript as JSONL for later judging and human review (P4)

spec_features.spec_quote: these are deliberate constraints, not oversights to optimize away
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code mechanism.
